description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Wind with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Wind Mode I (Cloud)] and [Wind Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Wind Mode I (Cloud)
description.text: Wind abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Wind abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 for equipped Wind abilities after casting 1/2/3+ Wind abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Wind Mode II (Cloud)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Wind Mode II (Cloud)
description.text: Wind abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Wind abilities trigger 1 additional time, instant cast speed for Wind abilities, grants [Dual SOLDIER Mode] to the user after using Wind abilities

description.name: Dual SOLDIER Mode
description.text: Critical chance =100%, critical hits deal 20% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient and other Critical Damage statuses), casts Dual Slash Impact after using a Wind ability

description.name: Dual Slash Impact
description.text: One single attack (4.45) capped at 49999/69999/89999 after 1/2/3 uses, ignores DEF, 100% hit rate

description.name: Attach Wind with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3
